verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS virtual-mailbox web service, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an analytics, cookie, or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items are the option to have mail not opened or scanned, 2FA, on-site shredding and HIPAA BAAs. These are adjacent privacy and security controls and earn no credit toward a telemetry opt-out.
